description: SP ENW - NDP - PRY BSP Generation is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - NDP - PRY & BSP Generation Capacity Headroom (New 2025 Publication) Primary & BSP Generation Capacity Headroom forecasts, as per SP Electricity North West's Network Development Plan ( NDP ) publication. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Forecasting Data, Capacity Data. Its keywords are Primary, BSP, Bulk, Supply, Point, NDP. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
